Quantum 1.6.0 was certified on 2026-07-13. It pins **nucleus v1.3.0**, **quark v1.2.2** and **orbit v1.4.0**.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.5.0: orbit goes from v1.3.0 to v1.4.0 (minor), nucleus stays at v1.3.0 and quark stays at v1.2.2.
